full_prompt_en: A square decorative painted illustration shows a pensive young woman leaning her cheek into one hand before a pale patterned wall. Her head tilts down toward the left and her gaze drops out of the frame, giving her softly parted lips and flushed cheeks a wistful stillness. Thick honey-brown hair is swept into braided waves around the crown and gathered behind her neck, with individual strands catching warm light. A deep green robe drapes from her shoulders and gathers in broad, heavy folds across the lower right. At the center of her neckline, a narrow ochre-gold panel shows beneath delicate off-white lace. Her visible hand supports the left side of her face, fingers tucked into the temple, while the other arm slips out of view near the lower edge. Behind her, pale stone or plaster is crowded with small branching lines, fragmented floral shapes, circular medallions, and washed gray, cream, and muted orange pieces. The ornament remains light enough to keep the head and dark green cloth dominant. Fine outlines articulate hair, lashes, lace, and wall detail, while skin is softly modeled with pink and cream tones and cloth is laid in blended, slightly textured color. Gentle diffuse light from the upper left brightens the brow, cheek, hand, and a few folds without making sharp shadows. The composition balances her large quiet face against the restless pale ornament, forming an intimate, melancholy image with handcrafted richness.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形装饰性绘画插画呈现一位沉思的年轻女子，脸颊倚在一只手上，身后是浅色纹饰墙。她的头向左下倾，目光垂向画外，微张的唇和泛红脸颊显得惆怅而静止。浓密蜜棕头发在头顶编成波浪状辫发，聚在颈后，独立发丝接住暖光。深绿色长袍从肩头垂下，在右下方汇成宽而沉的褶皱。领口中央，细窄赭金色衣片从精细米白蕾丝下露出。可见的手托住左脸，手指贴在太阳穴，另一臂在下缘附近隐去。背后的浅色石或灰泥表面挤满细枝状线、碎花形、圆形饰章，以及淡灰、奶油色和低饱和橙色小块。纹饰足够浅，使头部与深绿衣料仍然主导画面。细轮廓刻画头发、睫毛、蕾丝与墙上细节，肌肤用粉红和奶油色柔和塑形，布料则以融合而略有纹理的颜色铺开。温柔的漫射光从左上照亮眉额、面颊、手和几处衣褶，不形成锐影。构图让大而安静的面孔与躁动的浅色纹饰相平衡，形成手作丰富、亲密而忧郁的形象。
style_prompt_en: Decorative painted illustration combines finely articulated linework and softly modeled flesh with broad, weighty folds of saturated cloth. Set a clear dark focal mass against a pale surface filled with branching ornamental fragments, small floral shapes, and muted circular motifs. Keep background detail intricate but low in contrast so it supports the expression rather than competes. Use honey brown, deep green, cream, faded gray, and touches of ochre-gold, with gentle diffuse light on rounded forms. Preserve visible handcrafted texture and delicate edges in lace, hair, and pattern. A close, asymmetrical pose and quiet gaze give the richly worked frame an intimate, melancholy tone.
style_prompt_zh: 装饰性绘画插画将精细线条、柔和塑形的肤色与大块厚重饱和布褶结合。让清晰深色焦点团块对着浅色表面，后者密布分枝饰纹、小花形和低饱和圆纹。背景细节繁复却压低对比，衬托神情而不争夺注意。以蜜棕、深绿、奶油色、淡灰及赭金点缀配色，温柔漫射光落在圆润形体上。蕾丝、头发和图案边缘保留可见手作纹理与精细感。贴近的非对称姿态和安静目光令丰富加工的画面具有亲密忧郁的调子。
theme_en: A pensive woman in green before an intricate pale mosaic
theme_zh: 沉思的绿衣女子倚坐于浅色繁复纹饰前
name: Eleanor Vere Boyle
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
